component.name: HordePlayer
component.summary: Professional local video player powered by ffmpeg

description.p: HordePlayer plays any video link or local file in a clean, modern web UI. A small local ffmpeg server remuxes and transcodes MKV and AC3/E-AC3 audio that browsers cannot decode, with optional audio amplification and normalisation.

ul.li: Supports mp4, mkv, webm, mov, ts, HLS and DASH sources
Audio boost and EBU R128 loudness normalisation
Playlist, speed, loop, subtitles, PiP and fullscreen
